scientific_integrity: The general theorem has a symbolic upper bound and construction; the equality classification is a permutation equivalence. Two independent standalone exact checkers confirm the DNA census and directly verify examples. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Length-three codes over fixed-point-free paired even alphabets; exactly maximum Hamming distance three, reverse-complement closure, and ordinary comma-free splices. No optimality is asserted for other lengths, GC restrictions, or cross-bifix-free codes; incomplete historical full-text access leaves residual priority risk.
title: Sharp strand-closed maximum-distance comma-free trinucleotide codes
